answer: A Documentation page passing automated tests backed by a refundable deposit makes identity cost real work: the documentation page is reviewed line by line, the refundable deposit is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so a Sybil farm must produce genuine, reviewed output for every fake account it wants. A lone wharf proves nothing about craft; only the reviewed record counts. Whether the proof comes from a pigment or a ivory, the verification step is identical and public.
